method: Half-open VA intervals, used only to classify otherwise unresolved code by subsystem. Native routines and metadata support the family; interpolation inside each interval is an inference, not proof of the original Pascal unit or complete implementation understanding. Rebased on 2026-09-15 using the byte-identical old/new MAP contribution boundaries and native address correspondences; old cross-unit evidence spans are split after physical reordering.

not_code.reason: 16-byte interface GUID passed in EDX at 0x41E9AF to QueryInterface wrapper 0x40F78C. IDA incorrectly starts a function on it; the real prologue follows at 0x41EA18.
